_meta.description: Date/time lexicon for SmartCar WhatsApp bot (rule-based, no AI). Hebrew + English + transliteration.
_meta.holiday_dates_format: dates[year] = [start, end] inclusive (ISO). Multiple ranges are flattened pairs. 'erev' = eve (evening start). Israeli observance.
sources: hebcal.com (Israel mode, i=on) for 2026-2028 holiday dates
Ministry of Education vacation calendars as published by israelhayom.co.il, karamel.co.il (תשפ״ז) and srugim.co.il (תשפ״ו)
_meta.matching_tip: Normalize before matching: lowercase, strip niqqud, unify ״/"/'' and ׳/', collapse spaces; try longest phrase first.

relative_days.note: 'מאחר' is also 'late'; accept only when no other reading fits.
Past date; usually means the customer refers to an existing rental.
'שבוע הבא' without a weekday = same weekday next week (offset 7); with a weekday, use weekday rules.
'חודש הבא' may also mean the calendar month; ask for the exact date if needed.

weekdays.note: 'שני' alone also means 'two/second'; prefer weekday only with יום/ב/ל prefix or when no number context.
'שישי' / 'ששי' also 'sixth'; usually Friday in booking context.
Saturday; 'מוצאי שבת'/'מוצ״ש' = Saturday evening. Branches may be closed on Shabbat.

next.rule: Weekday + next/הבא: the occurrence in the following calendar week (Sunday-start week). If the same weekday this week has not passed yet and customer wrote only 'הבא', many Israelis still mean the nearest one; when the gap is under 7 days, confirm with the customer.

this.rule: Weekday + this/הקרוב (or weekday alone): the nearest future occurrence; if that weekday is today, use today only when the message implies today, otherwise +7.

after_next.rule: Weekday + after-next: nearest future occurrence + 7 days (or +14 from the same weekday this week).

weekday_modifiers.default_rule: A bare weekday means the nearest future occurrence (0=Sunday..6=Saturday). Israeli work week runs Sunday to Thursday; Friday is a half day; Shabbat (Saturday) branches are usually closed.

weekend.rule: Pick-up Friday (usually morning), return Sunday (morning). 'סופ״ש הבא' / 'next weekend' = the weekend of the following week; bare or 'הקרוב' = nearest upcoming Friday. 'סופ״ש ארוך' may be Thursday-Sunday (3 days) or Friday-Monday.

durations.note: Weekend rental = Friday pick-up to Sunday return = 2 rental days.
Monthly rental; 'חדש' is also 'new', match only in duration context.

months_note: 'מאי'/'may' and 'מרץ'/'mar' are also ordinary words; 'יוני'/'yoni' is also a name. Prefer month reading when next to a day number (e.g. '5 במאי').

holidays.name: יום כיפור
holidays.note: Country shuts down; no driving. Erev Yom Kippur afternoon is also closed.

holidays.name: סוכות
holidays.note: Full Sukkot week in Israel incl. Shmini Atzeret/Simchat Torah on the last day.

holidays.name: שמחת תורה
holidays.note: In Israel Shmini Atzeret and Simchat Torah are the same day.

holidays.name: חנוכה
holidays.note: Dates are the 8 days of Chanukah; first candle is lit on the evening of 'erev'. 2027 key = Chanukah starting Dec 2027 (ends 2028-01-01). Not a day off for most workplaces.

holidays.name: פורים
holidays.note: First date = Purim; second = Shushan Purim (Jerusalem).

holidays.name: פסח
holidays.note: Israel: 7 days. Seder night = erev. 'ליל הסדר'/'ערב פסח' map to erev date.

holidays.name: חול המועד
holidays.note: Generic 'חול המועד' = the NEXT upcoming one (Pesach or Sukkot) relative to today. Pairs of [start,end]. 2026 Pesach (04-03..04-07) is past.

holidays.name: יום העצמאות
holidays.note: Officially observed (shifted) dates. Erev = Yom HaZikaron (Memorial Day).

holidays.name: ל״ג בעומר
holidays.note: Bonfires on the evening before (erev). 'ל״ג' alone is also the number 33; use with care.

holidays.name: שבועות
holidays.note: 'שבועות' is also plural 'weeks' ('3 שבועות'); if preceded by a number it is a duration, not the holiday.

holidays.name: החגים
holidays.note: Tishrei holiday period from Erev Rosh Hashana to Shmini Atzeret/Simchat Torah. 'אחרי החגים' = day after end; 'לפני החגים' = before start.

holidays.name: חופש גדול
holidays.note: Elementary schools/kindergartens: 1 July - 31 August. Middle/high schools finish ~20 June (2026: last day 19 June; 2027: vacation from 21 June).

holidays.name: חופשת חנוכה
holidays.note: School break (Ministry of Education). 2026 (תשפ״ז) verified: classes off through 12 Dec, resume 13 Dec. 2027 and 2028 not yet published; estimated as 2nd day of Chanukah to last day — confirm.

holidays.name: חופשת פסח
holidays.note: School break (Ministry of Education). 2026 (תשפ״ו) and 2027 (תשפ״ז) verified. 2028 not yet published; estimated by the usual pattern (about 9 days before Pesach to last day) — confirm.
